title: Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract: Fee Waiver Reasons and Courtesy Waiver Conditions
content:
**Desk guidance on waivers, Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract.** The desk applies the following rule.

1. A fee can be waived only while the contract status is active, repossession assigned, repossessed or deficiency.
2. A fee transaction may be waived only once; the test is whether the contract's ledger already shows a waiver of that fee transaction.
3. Waivers are always of the whole fee transaction; partial waivers are not granted.
4. **Courtesy for on-time history** — a courtesy waiver for on-time history applies only to a late charge, and only when the contract's run of installments in a row without a late charge is at least the tier's required run and the courtesy waivers on the contract in the last 12 calendar months are below the tier's allowance; a tier whose allowance is 0 receives no courtesy waivers.
5. **Servicing error** — applies to any fee the company's own records show was caused by a company error, such as a payment posted late by Kestrel or an autopay draft taken on the wrong date, and is not limited in number.
6. **Bank error on a returned payment** — applies to a returned-payment fee when the customer's bank has confirmed in writing that the return was the bank's own error.
7. Repossession, transport, storage and condition-report expenses and extension fees are never courtesy-waived.

## Terms

- **Run of installments without a late charge:** the count of installment due dates after the due date of the installment the most recent late charge on the contract relates to (or from the first payment date when there is none) up to today.
- **Courtesy waivers in the last 12 calendar months:** the count of on-time-history courtesy waivers on the contract dated within the 12 calendar months ending on today's date, inclusive.

## Reasons at a glance

| Waiver reason | Fees it reaches | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| Courtesy for on-time history | a late charge only | run of installments without a late charge at least the tier's required run, and courtesy waivers in the last 12 calendar months below the tier's allowance (an allowance of 0 means none) |
| Servicing error | any fee the company's own records show was caused by a company error | not limited in number |
| Bank error on a returned payment | a returned-payment fee | the customer's bank has confirmed in writing that the return was the bank's own error |

Under every reason the contract must be in one of the four statuses in clause 1, the waiver is of the whole fee transaction, and a fee transaction already waived is not waived again. Repossession, transport, storage and condition-report expenses and extension fees are never waived as a courtesy.

*Hypothetical:* a Tier 3 contract shows 10 installments in a row without a late charge and no courtesy waiver in the last 12 calendar months; a late charge on it meets the courtesy conditions (run of at least 9, waivers below the allowance of 1). The same contract after one courtesy waiver in the last 12 calendar months no longer meets them.
